cohort.scope: Current active BTC public-account sample, not independent owners or market-wide coverage

selection_specification.candidates: Existing frozen public cohorts plus current BTC recentTrades participants; first 32 lexicographic addresses
selection_specification.caps: Capped histories are activity lower bounds, not certified total counts
selection_specification.selection: Observed BTC fill count in fixed source window descending, then address; no PnL fields used

specification.coverage: Sampled accounts and connection-observed public BTC trades. No venue-wide liquidation coverage or independent ownership claim.
specification.first_receipt: Immutable collector ingress on the main event loop; HTTP transport receipt stored separately.
specification.limit_policy: One connection, at most eight user subscriptions and one public BTC subscription. Admission/errors measured. Current published provider contract was unreachable; contract review remains a readiness blocker.
specification.metadata_policy: Explicit liquidation knowledge has its own first receipt. Later REST enrichment never borrows an earlier WS fill receipt.
specification.snapshot_policy: Every first user frame per connection and every isSnapshot frame is bootstrap. First REST sample per account is bootstrap. Bootstrap IDs never become new signals.
specification.spot_coverage: Inferred only from actual previously recorded trade-ID overlap, uninterrupted bounded polling, and fresh valid trades; not venue-certified completeness.
specification.wallet_selection: Observed recent BTC fill count, then address; no PnL ranking
